claim_level: priority-only proof-grade interval backend for the finite sampled Hermite dual row system at half-grid 256; not a continuous Hermite-family obstruction and not a live preledger pass

multiplier_stationarity_repair.method: Adjust the largest active sampled-gap multiplier by the exact rational gamma residual so sampled-gap multipliers sum exactly to 1. This avoids using any gamma residual cap.

exact_decimal_intake.note: Contract and strict-gap input number tokens are ingested losslessly as reduced BigInt rationals. Active multipliers are read from exact numerator/denominator pairs in the rationalization audit.

pi_interval.method: Machin formula pi = 16 atan(1/5) - 4 atan(1/239), each arctangent bounded by 8 alternating-series terms.

interval_method.trigonometric_enclosure: Argument reduction to a nearest quarter-turn with rational Taylor interval enclosures for sine and cosine on the residual angle.
interval_method.hermite_coefficients: Exact rational cubic Hermite coefficients at active sampled theta values.
interval_method.row_bounds: Outward rational intervals for active sampled gap bounds and field-speed sign bounds.

source_margin_containment.note: Every active gap base_gap and active speed base_signed_margin decimal recorded by the rationalization audit is checked for containment in the reconstructed outward interval bound.

limitations: The certificate closes only the finite sampled half-grid-256 Hermite row system used by the numerical LP.
It does not prove continuous-in-the-collar inequalities between samples.
It does not accept a repaired candidate, consume pre-ledger rows, authorize a branch chart, or update live causal ledgers.
conclusion: The selected exact-rational active multipliers and outward-rounded active row bounds prove a negative upper bound for the finite sampled Hermite dual row system.
